XECH Solar Beam Rechargeable Torch

Our Light, Anytime, Anywhere. Meet Solar Beam – the ultimate solar-powered light that works as a flashlight, emergency lamp, study light, and outdoor torch. Designed for people who like to stay prepared, Solar Beam is compact, powerful, and eco-friendly.

Why You’ll Love It:

  • Dual-charging: Solar + USB
  • Super bright LED with long battery backup
  • Lightweight and perfect for travel or outdoor adventures
  • Ideal for home use, reading, camping, and emergencies

Keep it in your emergency kit, backpack, bedside table, or use it as your go-to study or reading light. No electricity? No problem. Just soak up the sun and shine on.

Key Features:

  • MOQ 100 Units.
  • Price does not include GST, logo printing and delivery charges
  • Dual charging: can be charged via solar panel and via USB.
  • Bright LED light with long battery backup — holds enough charge for emergencies, reading, outdoor use etc.
  • Lightweight and portable — convenient for travel, camping, keeping in an emergency kit or backpack.
  • Multi-use design: functions as a flashlight / torch, emergency lamp, and reading/study light.
  • Eco-friendly: uses solar power so usable even when there is no electricity.
